text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — after doing an int8 PTQ pass on reranker-v3 (prod-ish config) I see a ~3% absolute drop in NDCG@10 on the holdout that contains raw HTML snippets. Looks fine on plain-text docs.

maria: Oof. Can you paste the command/args you used and the exact holdout?

kevin: Sure — small repro:```bash
python -m eval.run --model reranker-v3 --quant int8 --dataset=holdouts/qa_html_mixed.json --seed=42 --metric=ndcg@10
```Got ~0.842 -> 0.811 vs fp16 baseline ~0.844.

eval-bot: Quick smoke run finished: int8=0.8109, fp16=0.8441, delta=-0.0332 (p<0.01 on bootstrap).

sophia: Two immediate hypotheses: (1) tokenization shift with HTML tokens (tags counted as tokens), (2) quantization sensitivity on small attention heads if HTML adds weird long rare spans. Did you change tokenizer version?

kevin: We rolled tokenizer v2 two weeks ago (split rules changed for <...>), good call. I also noticed in preprocessing some docs are HTML-stripped and others are left as-is in the candidate pool — so distribution mismatch between train/holdout might amplify quantization fragility.

maria: Can you run a 1k sample baseline where we force both train and eval to the same doc formatter: (a) strip_html, (b) keep_html-escaped. We want to see if the gap is formatter-dependent.

kevin: Running both now. Command for formatting check:```bash
python -m eval.prep --input=raw/candidates.json --format=strip_html --out=work/strip.json
python -m eval.run --model reranker-v3 --quant=int8 --dataset=work/strip.json --metric=ndcg@10
```

ops-bot: CI job queued: rerank-ptq-html-scan #4578 (estimated 14m).

kevin: Early results on 1k sample: strip_html -> int8=0.842, fp16=0.845 (no meaningful gap). keep_html -> int8=0.809, fp16=0.846 (big gap). So looks strongly tied to keeping raw tags.

sophia: That implies tokenizer boundary + quantization. Short-term patch: canonicalize docs to strip tags before rerank. Long-term: either revert tokenizer change for tag handling, or add a small calibration pass on int8 with examples that include HTML-like tokens.

maria: Agree. Two action items: (A) apply HTML-strip preproc for the next canary and monitor NDCG/MRR; (B) run focused PTQ calibration with an HTML-augmented calibration set and re-evaluate.

kevin: I'll open a PR for the preproc change and kick a PTQ calibration run. Will also dump tokenization diffs for a few examples so we can inspect head activations.

maria: Please tag me and add a short reproducible script snippet and the bootstrap test so we can track in the rollout checklist.

kevin: Will do. If anyone has a quick idea for a lightweight feature test (maybe token-length histogram before/after), shout now — I'll include it in the CI job. :thumbsup:

sophia: Token-length hist + proportion of <...> tokens would be great. Also add a fallback policy note in rollout in case int8 causes regression in other weird-format docs.

kevin: Noted — adding hist and fallback to the PR description. Thanks all.
